verdict.rationale: TruffleHog's CLI supports a documented `--fail` flag and `--since-commit` for diff-scoped scans, and a hands-on probe confirmed the binary exits non-zero (183) when verified findings are present and 0 when clean — exactly the exit-code behavior needed to fail a CI build. While docs focus on pre-commit/pre-receive hooks rather than a named CI-action, the same CLI invocation pattern is directly usable in any CI pipeline (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins) since it's a portable binary/Docker image.
